5578: The main character of the story. Kaiji is poor, downtrodden and lazy - he lives by himself in a slum and is constantly in debt. He bides his time by playing cheap gambling games with neighbors, though he always loses.
6890: Debtor and one-time coworker of Kaiji. One year before the first tournament on Espoir, he lured Kaiji into cosigning a loan for him, making Kaiji liable in case Furuhata did not repay the loan.
6891: A bespectacled, fat man who forms and alliance with Kaiji and Furuhata after losing all of his gesture cards.
8470: A man whom Kaiji saved from the other room on the Espoir on a whim. Participates in the human derby to clear his wife's debts.
8471: Kaiji's coworker who wants money to "get his big shot" at life. Participates in the human derby.
9129: Kazutaka Hyoudou's right-hand man and the CEO of the Teiai Corporation. He oversees the majority of Teiai's diabolic gambles and possesses keen powers of observation.
13421: Kitami is a clear-headed man who Kaiji encounters on the Espoir. He came up with the strategy of buying up all the rock cards and holding them constant; as the other cards deplete, he and his men then prey on those who have scissor cards.
14057: Wealthy socialite and president of the powerful financial consulting firm "Love Emperor", not to mention owner and sponsor of underground gambling tournaments like those onboard Espoir. Hyōdō Kazutaka is believed to be seventy years old and worth several hundred billion yen.
17959: A dirty loan shark with ties to the yakuza. He lends out large sums of money to the desperate, but charges an absurd (and illegal) interest rate. He tracks down Kaiji after a client of his, Furuhata, disappeared without repaying a loan, which Kaiji cosigned in an act of weakness.
26277: Jouji Funai is one of the veterans (or Repeater) of previous voyages on the Espoir. Funai is an excellent conman and uses the fears and worries of the other competitors to his advantage.
27880: A run-of-the-mill guy stuck at his dead-end job. At the very least, he wants people to look up to him. Has pride in his physical strength from his long years doing manual labor.
32415: The young, ambitious manager of an underground casino owned by the Teiai Corporation. He is the mastermind of the Bog, a rigged pachinko machine in which every ball is worth 4,000 yen, with a payout of over 500 million. He is Kaiji's opponent in the second part of the manga.
36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
42135: Ootsuki is the foreman of Kaiji's gang in the underground labor camp. While he initially appears to be kind and helpful, in reality, he is just setting Kaiji up for an even bigger fall. He is the mastermind behind the dice game Chinchirorin.
43663: Sakazaki's beloved daughter, who harbors a crush on Kaiji.
43925: A middle aged man, security guard whose daughter and wife left him because of his economical problems. He's been looking for a young gambler to help him since then to beat the Bog and win enough money to buy a house so his wife and daughter will return to him.
44419: Another person in group E paying off their debts by working in the underground labor camps. He keeps a record of all the wins in Chinchirorin which makes Kaiji realise how Ōtsuki is cheating. He and several others earning 4,500 pelica help Kaiji defeat Ōtsuki.
46617: Murakami runs the operations at the illegal casino. He acts as Ichijou's right-hand man and roommate and is the only other person entrusted with the responsibility of adjusting the nail settings on the Bog.
46935: The new right-hand man of Hyoudou and best candidate for succeding him, after Tonegawa's defeat. He watches over the underground labour camp and he is the superior of Ichijou, which is his favourite one.
130702: Nishio is the female coworker of Kaiji and Sahara at the convenient store. She only appears in the same episode she was introduced in and has a single line of dialogue. Her notable feature is that she was the first female character seen in the series.
145417: One of Ootsuki's underlings in the underground.
145418: One of Ootsuki's underlings in the underground, and his right-hand man in Underground Chinchiro.
